item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Earth, Sun and the apparent motion of the sky
item.stem: Meera looks at the stars from her rooftop in Jaipur at 9 p.m. in January. When she looks again at 9 p.m. in June, different stars are visible in the night sky. Which motion of the Earth causes this change in the stars seen at the same time of night?

options.A: the Earth rotating on its own axis
options.B: the Earth revolving around the Sun
options.C: the Moon revolving around the Earth
options.D: the Sun rotating on its own axis
